claim: Reduce opportunity loss in positive SPY regimes by replacing a controlled slice of idle cash with SPY exposure.
causal_mechanism: The audit shows 2023 and 2025 underperformance with cash above 80% and very low exposure; partial SPY fallback should recover upside that the champion left on the table in bull regimes.
expected_effect: Reduce opportunity loss in positive SPY regimes by replacing a controlled slice of idle cash with SPY exposure.
falsification_rule: Reject if drawdown breaks -20, CAGR does not exceed SPY, or the fallback merely increases exposure without improving any parent DD20 metric materially.

empirical_basis.reason: Champion audit and bad-period metrics show high cash / low exposure in weak years.

metadata.expected_effect: Replace 25/50/75% of idle cash with SPY only when SPY regime is positive.
metadata.why_this_should_help: 2023/2025 were dominated by high cash and missed upside; controlled SPY fallback targets that specific opportunity loss.
metadata.success_rule: max_drawdown_pct no worse than -20; CAGR must exceed SPY; and improve at least one material metric versus parent DD20.
metadata.rejection_rule: Reject if DD < -20, CAGR <= SPY, or no parent metric improves materially.

risk_of_overfit: Controlled: evidence-driven and limited to 12 variants.
novelty_reason: Derived directly from the latest DD20 champion audit and bad-period evidence.
why_not_duplicate: Each variant changes one controlled lever within spy_fallback_partial rather than making random parameter noise.
